mentions.name: Rust-to-Fil-ABI compiler support
mentions.description: A toolchain effort to compile Rust to Fil-ABI so Rust and Fil-C can interoperate without weakening either language's guarantees. About a third of the way through; needed to get librsvg working in Fil-GNOME.
mentions.source_excerpt: about 1/3 of the way through getting Rust to compile to Fil-ABI. This means you can interop between Rust and Fil-C without weakening either language’s guarantees.
mentions.author: pizlonator
